handoffs.message: Ready for review: PR #1264 https://github.com/ajoe734/pantheon/pull/1264. Commits ae66f238 and 4baf2331 add the MPOS Observe Backend Matrix (G6), link the gap dispatch closure artifact, and add docs regression coverage. Validation after rebase: python3 -m pytest tests/docs/test_mpos_backend_maturity_matrix.py -q (4 passed); python3 -m pytest tests/governance/test_qlib_proof_artifacts.py tests/governance/test_statsmodels_proof_artifacts.py tests/governance/test_quantlib_proof_artifacts.py -q (16 passed); python3 -m pytest tests/integrations/test_research_no_order_route.py -q (3 passed).

Review approved: 23/23 tests pass, MPOS matrix covers all 4 backends with correct posture and no-order-route guarantees, dispatcher consistency verified (QuantLib absent from default fanout as documented), G6 closure link correct. Returning to Codex for closeout.
